name: EmoAI Content Reaction Agent
description: Analyzes how consenting viewers react to video content (ads, trailers, broadcast clips, training videos). Combines facial expression (FACS action units), voice, and speech cues with a per-person neutral baseline to report emotion, attention, interest, and engagement over time, and answers follow-up questions about specific segments. Not a medical device; not for employee monitoring, hiring, or individual student evaluation.

oauth2.description: OAuth 2.0 authorization code flow. Supports Dynamic Client Registration for Gemini Enterprise.

scopes.analysis:read: Read analysis results and ask follow-up questions

skills.name: Create a viewing test
skills.description: Creates a shareable viewing-test link for a piece of content. Participants give consent, turn on their webcam, and watch; each recording is synced to the content timeline and sent automatically for reaction analysis. Returns the link and live participation status.
examples: Create a viewing test for this 30-second ad and send me the link.
How many participants have completed the trailer test so far?

skills.name: Analyze content reaction
skills.description: Analyzes viewer recordings collected through a viewing test, or uploaded recordings of consenting viewers synced to the content timeline, and returns segment-by-segment emotion, attention, interest, and engagement curves, peak and drop-off moments, and a written summary. Each viewer is analyzed against their own neutral-face baseline.
examples: Analyze how the test audience reacted to this 30-second ad.
Where did viewers lose interest in this trailer?
Summarize the emotional peaks in this episode preview.

skills.name: Compare content versions
skills.description: Compares viewer reactions across two or more cuts of the same content (A/B test) and reports which version held attention and drove stronger positive reactions, segment by segment.
examples: Compare reactions to version A and version B of this ad.
Which ending kept viewers more engaged?

skills.name: Explain a segment
skills.description: Answers follow-up questions about a completed analysis, citing the facial action units, voice, and speech cues behind each finding.
examples: Which scene produced the strongest positive reaction?
